18/S0.subgoal: Recap the previous lecture and provide an overview of the tracking technologies to be discussed in the current lecture.

18/S1.subgoal: Describe the two types of electromechanical trackers: world-fixed and wearable.

18/S2.subgoal: Explain how electromagnetic and acoustic tracking technologies work for position measurement.

18/S3.subgoal: Explain the various categories of vision-based tracking, including infrared, visible light (fiducial, natural feature, and model-based), and 3D structure tracking.

18/S4.subgoal: Describe 3D structure tracking and inertial tracking technologies.

18/S5.subgoal: Describe other tracking methods including GPS, motion capture, eye tracking, and hybrid systems.

18/S6.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
